selected_evidence.summary: DNF history records a successful `upgrade --security` transaction; the final repository check reports no pending security updates.
The JSON and CSV remained valid and retained identical SHA-256 fingerprints and contents after updating and rebooting.

Captured a healthy pre-restart baseline, received restart acknowledgement, observed boot ID change from e625b9a5-4242-499a-88da-9a76ecf86fe1 to 0f2cad45-14c6-434c-b5e9-f05bb4c70686, and verified updated-kernel, service, and inventory recovery.
